pages.text: Carry energy in your pocket - the $(bold)Portable Akaishi Energy Cell$() is an energy bank that travels with you.$(br2)Hold it in your $(bold)main or off hand$() and it will automatically spend Chi Energy to repair the durability of all equipped Akaishi gear (100 Chi per durability point).

Three tiers of portable cells:$(li)$(bold)Basic$(): 50M capacity, repairs 10 durability/tick$(li)$(bold)Advanced$(): 200M capacity, repairs 20 durability/tick$(li)$(bold)Super$(): 1B capacity, repairs 40 durability/tick$(br2)When depleted, place the cell in the charging slot of a $(bold)Chi Energy Cell$() to recharge automatically.
The Super cell requires Condensed Akaishi Essence Blocks.
